delta.vocabulary_note: Deltas describe what this window’s record showed across its compared halves (past tense); they evaluate the record and predict nothing. insufficient_extraction means the feeding field did not meet the evidence floor in this window — starved extraction or too little history; the signal’s *_basis counts (input/empty per half) distinguish which.
